messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync  last night's VPC onboarding window had intermittent webhook auth failures affecting 11 tenants. Fix deployed at 03:05 UTC and replay started. Need outbound notice, small credits, and AE flags for renewal-risk accounts.

Diego Rivera: Root cause: token refresh returned a rotated KMS key id and code didn't handle the case, causing auth errors. Hotfix added null-check and fallback. Replay confirmed 9/11 progressed. Posting runbook links shortly.

Ruth Chen: Draft outbound (short):
Hi <Name>, we resolved an onboarding delivery issue overnight that may have delayed setup. We've replayed events and are offering credits and hands-on help. Reply or join office hours to get assisted.

Aisha Khan: Credit recs: Enterprise 10% of one month commit, Mid 5%, SMB $100. Office hours: Wed 14:00 UTC and Thu 02:00 UTC. We'll prioritize enterprise callback list.

Diego Rivera: For ops: replay endpoint `POST /internal/tenants/{id}/webhook/replay`. I'll add verification counts and add an alert for token-refresh errors >1/min.

ops-bot: Incident INC-1754321987 created  Severity P2. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1754321987

Aisha Khan: Plan: Ruth to send emails at 13:30 UTC, Diego to verify replays, AEs to call flagged enterprise accounts. After-send paste final copy and list of customers who accepted help here.

Ruth Chen: Sending at 13:30 UTC. Final copy will be posted after send.
